notes: Imdex5 (src/Imdex5.sol) is the whole application: an index of the five largest tokens paired with IMD on Ethereum mainnet (chain id 1), whose own ERC-20 share is 'The Imdex 5' (IMDEX5, 18 decimals, plain transfers, supply 0 at deployment, no cap; mint issues, redeem burns, nothing else mints). Contracts only: no launch token, pool or website. The constructor takes no arguments, calls no contract and checks no code length; it seeds the starting list (1282 INFER, 1283 MARG, 737 ZTO, 1075 SCAT, 1175 SC with the brief's token and hook addresses) and sets listCount to 5. Every chain value is a constant in the source: IMD 0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7, Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, registries 0xA47FcB220DDd1cDddA865F89029BEc1b9EcA3bf1 and 0x7c9D5ee697BfF5Ac4F10E2E54d3f40c44e48fE23, Intake 0xa43e6F75ee006411F79Ac1C84120606C2330DE82 with action oracle.request@oracle-1 at 0.5 IMD, oracle signer 0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982 (EIP-712 domain 'IdentityMD Oracle' version 2 bound to this chain and this contract), pool key fee 12500 and tick spacing 60 with hooks = the launch's hook. There is no owner, admin, role, setting, pause or upgrade, so no $owner argument exists and nothing is assigned to the factory or IMD. Anyone calls everything: fund, mintFirst, mint, redeem, redeemToImd, claim, ask, submit, rebalance and closeRequest; onOracleResult and onOracleFailure accept only the Intake. Accounting is internal (held[coin], idleImd, feeImd), the 0.50% fee on mints, redeems and redeemToImd goes to feeImd, which pays only the 0.5 IMD oracle price and the 0.25 IMD caller rewards. State changes are nonReentrant and emit events. Compiled with solc 0.8.26, optimizer 200 runs, via_ir, cancun, bytecode_hash none; runtime is under 24,576 bytes and contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT.
